name: Agent manager
author: Brett
description: Create, edit, manage and orchestrate AI agents built from personas, lingo, skills and tools, each with its own persistent memory. Wizards for agents, skills, tools, an all-in-one agent builder and training (Firecrawl, web pages, the repo, MCP). Add-on agents: Mosses (React/TS/Python coder with container write mode), AXF expert, AI expert. Agents follow the framework contract agent-definition@1, so other AXF apps load the same ones. Works with the AI assistant when both are installed.

builtWith.rebuildOf: Opus build of Oct 18 2026 (pending item agent-manager-plugin)
